concerns.text: T106 mandates Adapter records carry `confidence_score` and `exclude_from_stats: true`, but experiment_log.schema.yaml sets `additionalProperties: false` and defines neither field. Compliant T106 output will fail T112's schema validation, and T109's filter depends on these fields. Either the contract must be amended or the task must store these outside the schema-validated records — the contradiction silently weakens both FR-003 logging and the T112 gate.

SC-002 (verify the dataset contains required variables emotional reactivity and cultural identity) has no implementing or verification task; the coverage table lists SC-003 and SC-005 but omits SC-002. A success criterion has been silently dropped.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T103 vs spec.md:FR-002/Key Entities and contracts/experiment_log.schema.yaml
concerns.text: T103's label vocabulary is {'high_reactivity', 'cultural_friction', 'neutral'} while the spec, Key Entities, and the experiment-log schema use 'escalating'/'cultural-friction'/'neutral-monitoring'. No task maps training labels to the `injected_state` values logged at inference, so FR-002/FR-003 traceability is broken at the vocabulary level.

Plan task T028b — validate that logged `injected_state` matches the injected instruction template (US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1: 'the instruction string matches a predefined set of templates... and the specific state label that triggered it is logged') — has no successor in T101–T114. The re-plan note claims 'No test or constraint was weakened,' but this acceptance criterion is dropped.

Plan tasks T043a (`tests/unit/test_classifier.py`, FR-002 logic tests) and T043b (`tests/unit/test_evaluator.py`, FR-005 logic tests) have no successor task. T104 audits independence but does not test classifier prediction or evaluator gap-score calculation; FR-002/FR-005 unit-test acceptance criteria are silently dropped.

T109/T110 exclude `neutral-monitoring` adapter records from the primary comparison. The spec's edge case only authorizes the neutral fallback injection, never post-hoc exclusion of adapter runs from the paired analysis; excluding adapter-side records while keeping all static records breaks the paired design and biases FR-006/SC-001. This selection rule needs spec-level authorization or an ITT-style analysis.

US-1 requires generation to complete within 30 minutes within memory capacity on a CPU-only runner. No task measures or verifies generation runtime or memory usage (T107 covers only inference throughput/latency). The acceptance criterion is dropped.

report.schema.yaml defines a per-LLM report object (required `llm_id`, `comparison`, `correction_applied`), but T110 produces a single aggregated `stats_report.json` with different keys (`test_type`, `statistic`, ...). T110's verification claims validation against this schema, which will fail as specified; the artifact shape must be reconciled.

FR-002 says the classifier is 'trained on metadata tags'; the plan summary says 'dynamic text features'; T103 derives labels solely from metadata tags. The three artifacts disagree on the classifier's training signal — reconcile to one definition before execution, since T104's independence audit depends on it.
